To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
TiO2 hollow sphere composites were synthesized by a novel, simple method and their photocatalytic activity under visible light irradiations was studied.
TiO2–carbon sphere composites were constructed by using prefabricated, highly uniform carbon sphere templates and TiO2 hollow spheres were obtained by the removal of the templates with calcination.
the TiO2 hollow structure obtained by the removal of CS templates has superior photocatalytic performance compared to the TiO2 composite.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the utilization of CSs as a template for the preparation of TiO2–carbon sphere composites and hollow structures.
the utilization of cheap carbon nanospheres in the production of highly active and stable TiO2 hollow photocatalysts.
the utilization of CS templates in the synthesis of photocatalysts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the TiO2 hollow structure is an effective photocatalyst for phenol degradation under visible light, and its stability was proven by repeated use.
the TiO2 HS photocatalyst prepared by the present work is an excellent candidate for the removal of organic contaminants from wastewater.

the photocatalytic activity of TiO2–carbon spheres composite is lower than the activity of the TiO 2–HS, and it was established that the photocatalysis is more sensitive to the crystal phase composition than the morphology of the catalyst.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CSs are suitable templates for the production of TiO2 HSs.
TiO2 hollow spheres with high photocatalytic efficiency were obtained via a facile, cost effective method, using carbon spheres as templates.
TiO2–carbon sphere composites are easy to prepare and have a simple structure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CSs could be used as a template for the synthesis of highly active photocatalysts, which are also stable and can be easily recovered from the reaction mixture.
the utilization of CSs as templates for the synthesis of TiO2 hollow spheres is an easy and effective route to prepare highly active photocatalysts.
CSs can be successfully utilized in the production of TiO2–carbon sphere and hollow structures, and the latter is a superior photocatalyst.
